author: rally
body:
# Author releases full-scene native fixture; request derived real package

Author explicitly directed formal task, commit/push all dirt, then execute. AgonArcade checkpointc96a55d pushed; task /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/FULL-SCENE-PLAN.md FS-001-01..06. Extend native fixture to full R27-05 scrolling panorama/HUD/title/audio and eZ80-controlled centerline player, VDP opponents/contact/native projection. Preserve R27-05 and existing flat fixture/deliveries. No autonomous scheduler/effects/new gameplay-policy tranche.

Rally-owned new source /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/full-scene/full-scene.golem SHA256 c62aee2851a3ac39c859a61bc45684a1ce9e384aab623b3c7730a0f97d39d6b4. Derived from accepted demo; removes all Tick120 player auto-advancement. eZ80 publishes complete playerStation/playerLateral/renderPhase/renderSteering before each finite Tick120 (same globals/bindings); speed remains eZ80/audio-side. Init/reset camera station3270000 (=Fuji lap-6800), phase0, opponents progress/position60000,50000,40000,30000,20000,10000 and historical initial lateral placement. Contact checks compare opponent against playerStation+6800, normalized by existing lap logic, matching R27 contact location. Init/render/stop/helper bindings, resource50300..50305 and finite entry ABI stay as-is; no helper changes requested. playerUnwrapped retained unused for source-layout continuity. Typed checked arithmetic stays.

Please build/deliver a NEW real generated/native package for this source with existing bindings/helper/firmware using your maintained compiler/SDK; export source/layout/backends/package/identity evidence as before, without changing original candidate. This necessary source rebinding/build is within the Author-released full-scene task and prior owner fences. Rally owns MOS C++ driver/full scene/assets/timing/profile and independent world verification. Need SDK/glue changes only if concrete build problem requires them; report any new shared semantic choice before changing it. Matching existing firmware8da2ebf... preferred if no API changes.

I am coding the eZ80 driver in parallel. Please reply with package path/interfaces when ready, or a blocking question. No graphical launch, hardware flash, capacity stress or autonomous scheduler requested.
